title: A single-cell chromatin immunocleavage sequencing \(scChIC-seq)
protocol: Dialyze antibody to remove impurities against PBSE using a Slide+A+Lyzer Dialysis Cassette.
Incubate the dialysis cassette at room temperature for 1 hour while stirring.
Transfer the dialysis cassette to fresh PBSE and continue to stir overnight at 4°C.
Pierce Traut's Reagent in water to achieve a final concentration of 14.53 mM.
Solubilize MNase in PBS containing 40% glycerol to achieve a final concentration of 0.24 mM.
Mix 6.4 µL of 14.53 mM Traut's Reagent and 200 µL of 0.24 mM MNase in a 1.5 mL tube.
Incubate the mixture at room temperature for 1 hour.
Desalt the reaction using four G50 columns per reaction.
Add 600 µL PBSE.
Spin at 750xg for 30 seconds.
Dump the flow through.
Repeat once again.
Add 600 µL PBSE.
Spin at 750xg for 1 minute.
Load 50 µL reaction per column.
Spin at 750xg for 1 minute.
Collect the eluent containing desalted reaction products.
Mix 100 µg antibody with 1.5 µL of 3 mg/mL SMCC dissolved in DMSO.
Incubate at room temperature for 30 minutes.
Desalt using G50 columns, and pool the eluents.
Add MNase-traut to the desalted Ab-SMCC or PA-SMCC at a molecular ratio of 1:10.
Incubate at room temperature for 1 hour.
Add 1 M Tris (pH 7.4) to achieve a final concentration of 50 mM.
Add glycerol to reach a final concentration of 40% v/v.
Store the mixture at -20°C until use.
Ensure that the cultured cells are evenly distributed in the cell culture medium.
Add 1/15 volume of 16% formaldehyde solution (methanol-free) to the medium.
Incubate at room temperature for 5 min while gently mixing using a tube-rotator.
Add 1/10 volume of 1.25 M glycine to terminate cell fixing.
Incubate at room temperature for 5 min while gently mixing using a tube-rotator.
Centrifuge at 1,320 rpm, 4°C for 7 min to collect the fixed cells.
Wash with PBS twice.
Resuspend cells in PBS and divide into 10^6 cells per 1.5-mL tube.
Snap-freeze tubes on dry ice and store at -80°C until use.
Pre-treat fixed-cells using 1 mL RIPA buffer for 30 min while rotating at room temperature.
Rinse with 1 mL binding buffer twice.
Resuspend in 1 mL binding buffer.
In 50 µL binding buffer, add 0.72 µL PA-MNase and 0.5 µL Ab.
Incubate the mixture at 4°C for 30 min.
Add the above Ab+PA-MNase or Ab-MNase to fixed-cells in the binding buffer.
Incubate the cells with Ab+PA-MNase or Ab-MNase at 4°C and gently mix using a tube-rotator for 30 min.
Spin down the cells at 2,000 rpm for 2 min.
Rotate the tube 180 degrees in the centrifuge.
Spin down the cells to the opposite side of the tube by centrifugation at 2,000 rpm for 1 min.
Remove the supernatant without over-drying.
Add 200 µL wash buffer.
Spin down the cells and remove the supernatant again.
Repeat the washing step twice more for a total of three washes.
Rinse cells with 1 mL Sorting buffer.
Resuspend cells in 200 μL Sorting buffer.
Filter cell solution using a cell strainer.
Sort cells to a single cell into a PCR tube containing 20 μL Sorting buffer.
Spin down the sample to collect the single cell at the bottom of the tube.
Keep samples on ice.
Activate MNase by adding 100 µL cold RSB per PCR tube.
Incubate the mixture at 37°C for 3 min using a water bath.
Add 100 μL stop buffer containing 1 μL proteinase K to each sample.
Mix well and incubate overnight at 65°C.
Purify DNA by phenol-chloroform extraction.
Add 125 μL of phenol-chloroform to the reaction mixture in a 1.5 mL tube.
Vortex the mixture thoroughly.
Centrifuge for 5 minutes at 13 krpm.
Prepare a new 1.5-mL tube containing 13.5 μL glycogen salt solution (1 µL 20 mg/mL Glycogen and 12.5 µL 3 M NaOAc [pH 5.3]).
Transfer the upper phase to the new tube.
Add 330 μL of 100% ethanol.
Incubate on dry-ice for 20 minutes.
Centrifuge for 15 minutes at 13 krpm at 4°C.
Remove the supernatant (do not over-dry).
Rinse pellets once using 400 µL cold 70% ethanol.
Air-dry the pellet briefly (do not over-dry).
Resuspend the pellet in 4 μL Qiagen EB (Qiagen).
End-repair the DNA using the End-It™ DNA End-Repair Kit (Lucigen) as follows.
Add 2.75 µL H2O, 1 µL of 10x dNTP mix, 1 µL of 10x ATP mix, and 1 µL of 10x end-repair enzyme buffer to each tube.
Add 0.25 µL End-Repair Enzyme Mix to the tubes.
Mix well.
Incubate at 37°C for 20 minutes.
Stop the reaction by adding 115 µL Tris-EDTA Buffer [pH 7.5].
Perform phenol-chloroform extraction as described above.
Vortex-mix well.
Spin as before.
Transfer the upper phase to a new tube.
Precipitate DNA with 13.5 μL of mixture containing 1 µL of 20 mg/ml Glycogen and 12.5 µL of 3 M NaOAc [pH5.3].
Add 340 µL ethanol.
Incubate on dry ice for 20 minutes.
Centrifuge at 13 krpm for 15 minutes at 4°C.
Remove supernatant.
Rinse pellet with 400 µL cold 70% ethanol.
Remove supernatant.
Air dry pellets without over-drying.
Resuspend pellet in 5 µL Qiagen EB.
Add 10 µL of reaction mix for DNA end A-addition.
Mix H2O, NEB2 buffer, dATP, and Klenow Exo- as specified.
Transfer all to PCR tube.
Incubate at 37°C for 20 minutes.
Incubate at 75°C for 20 minutes.
Store at 4°C.
Prepare adaptor ligation reaction with specified components.
Incubate at room temperature for 3 hours.
Add 0.4 µL of each 10 µM Indexing primer.
Add 15.8 µL of 2x Phusion Master Mix.
Add 0.4 µL of 10 µM common PCR primer 1.0.
Perform PCR at 98°C for 30 min.
For 25 cycles, perform each cycle as follows: 98°C for 10 min; 68°C for 30 min; 72°C for 30 min.
After the cycles, incubate at 72°C for 5 min.
Hold at 4°C.
Pool PCR products and purify DNA using MiniElute columns (Qiagen).
Elute with a total of 40 µL of 10 mM Tris, pH 7.5.
Load 16 µL of PCR product onto a 2% E-gel without dilution.
Run agarose gel electrophoresis for 22 min.
Isolate fragments of 140 to 350 bp in size by cutting out the desired gel and transferring them to 1.5-mL Eppendorf tubes.
Add 900 µL Buffer QG per tube to solubilize the gel by rotating for 20 min at room temperature.
Add 300 µL isopropanol to each tube.
Transfer the solution to one Mini Column (700 μl first, and spin), then transfer remaining solution and spin.
Wash once with 500 µl QG.
Wash once with 700 µL PE wash buffer (with ethanol), spin for 10 sec, discard solution, then spin for 2 min.
Elute DNA with 20 µL EB.
Prepare assay mix: 200 µL Qubit buffer + 1 µL dye.
Add the assay mix to the control and sample solutions as follows.
For 0 ng/μL control: 190 µL assay mix + 10 µL control DNA solution.
For 10 ng/μL control: 190 µL assay mix + 10 µL control DNA solution.
For sample: 198 µL above mix + 2 µL DNA sample.
Incubate 1 min at room temperature.
Measure by Qubit (double stranded DNA HS mode), calibrate DNA concentration by setting the volume mode 2 μL.
Run NGS using DNA sample prepared at the desired concentration.

In 50 μL binding buffer, add 0.72 μL PA-MNase.
Add 0.5 μL Ab for ChIPAb+ Trimethyl-Histone H3 \[Lys4].
Incubate at 4°C for 30 min.
Transfer pre-treated cells in binding buffer to desired cell concentration in 50 µL.
Add this cell solution and the pre-incubated complex from step 3 \(Ab-PA-MNase or Ab-MNase).
So the total volume becomes 100 μL.
Incubate at 4°C and gently mix by the tube-rotator for 30 min.
Spin down the cells at 2,000 rpm for 2 min.
Rotate the tube 180 degrees in the centrifuge.
Centrifuge to the opposite side of the tube at 2,000 rpm for 1 min.
Remove the supernatant, leaving a small quantity of buffer.
Add 200 µL wash buffer.
Spin down the cells and remove supernatant as before.
Repeat twice for a total of three washes.
Rinse with rinsing buffer (10 mM Tris [pH7.5] + 10 mM NaCl + 0.1% Triton X-100).
Add 200 µL rinsing buffer and spin at 2,000 rpm for 2 min.
Rotate tube in centrifuge and spin at 2,000 rpm for another 1 min.
Remove supernatant without over-drying.
Activate MNase by adding 40 µL RSB solution (RSB solution: 10 mM Tris [pH7.5] + 10 mM NaCl + 0.1% Triton X-100 + 2 mM CaCl₂).
Incubate at 37°C for 3 min using water bath.
Add 100 µL stop buffer containing 1 µL proteinase K (Stop buffer: 20 mM Tris [pH8.0] + 20 mM NaCl + 0.2% SDS + 10 mM EGTA).
Mix well and incubate overnight at 65°C.
Transfer to a 1.5-mL tube after this step.

Vortex the mixture.

Add 2.75 µL H2O, 1 µL 10x dNTP mix, 1 µL 10x ATP mix, and 1 µL 10x end-repair enzyme buffer to each tube.
Add 0.26 µL End-repair enzyme mix to the tubes.
Mix well.
Incubate at 37°C for 20 min.
Stop the reaction by adding 115 µL Tris-EDTA buffer (pH 7.5).
Proceed with phenol-chloroform extraction as described previously.
Vortex-mix well.
Spin as before.
Transfer the upper phase to a new tube.
Precipitate DNA with 13.5 µL of mixture containing 1 µL of 20 mg/ml Glycogen and 12.5 µL of 3 M NaOAc [pH 5.3], followed by adding 340 µL ethanol.
Incubate on dry ice for 20 minutes.
Centrifuge at 13 krpm for 15 minutes at 4°C.
Remove supernatant and rinse pellet with 400 µL cold 70% ethanol.
Remove supernatant and air-dry pellets without over-drying.
Resuspend pellet in 5 µL Qiagen EB.
Add A to DNA ends by mixing 2.7 µL H₂O, 1 µL 10x NEB2 buffer, 1 µL 10mM dATP, and 0.3 µL Klenow Exo- in a total reaction volume of 10 µL.
Incubate at 37°C for 20 min, then incubate at 75°C for 20 min, and store at 4°C.
Perform adaptor ligation by mixing 1.8 µL H₂O, 1.4 µL 10x T4 DNA ligase buffer, 0.8 µL 15 µM Illumina Adaptor Oligo Mix, and 1 µL of 400 U/µL T4 DNA ligase in a total reaction volume of 15 µL.
Incubate the ligation mixture at room temperature for 3 hours.
Add 0.4 μL each 10 μM Indexing primer.
Add 15.8 μL 2x Phusion Master Mix.
Add 0.4 μL 10 μM common PCR primer 1.0.
Perform PCR cycling: Initial denaturation at 98°C for 30 min; followed by 18 cycles of 98°C for 10 min, 68°C for 30 min, and 72°C for 30 min; final extension at 72°C for 5 min.
Load 16 μL PCR product onto a 2% E-gel without dilution.
Run agarose gel electrophoresis for 22 min.
Cut out the fragments of 140 to 350 bp in size from the gel.
Transfer the cut-out gel fragments into 1.5-mL Eppendorf tubes.
Add 900 μL Buffer QG per tube and rotate for 20 min at room temperature.
Add 300 μL isopropanol to each tube.
Transfer the solution to one Mini Column, spin down, and repeat with remaining solution if necessary.
Wash once with 500 μL QG buffer.
Wash once with 700 μL PE wash buffer (with ethanol).
Discard the PE wash buffer solution after spinning for 10 sec.
Spin again for 2 min to remove residual buffer.
Elute DNA with 20 μL EB.
Prepare assay mix: Mix 200 μL Qubit buffer and 1 μL dye.
Add 190 μL assay mix and 10 μL control DNA solution for the 0 ng/μL control.
Add 190 μL assay mix and 10 μL control DNA solution for the 10 ng/μL control.
Mix 198 μL above mix with 2 μL DNA sample.
Incubate for 1 minute at room temperature.
Measure DNA concentration using Qubit in double-stranded DNA HS mode.
Calibrate DNA concentration by setting the volume mode to 2 µL.
Run NGS using the DNA sample prepared at the desired concentration.
